n-k-k7-02.title: Ixesha elinye leeshedyuli ezintathu
n-k-k7-02.goal: Guqula ukufumaneka okucingelwayo kwabantu abathathu kube yimeko ezichanekileyo, wakhe amaxesha amaninzi okudibana anelisa bonke, ubone ukuba utshintsho olunye lutshintsha ukhetho njani.
n-k-k7-02.material:
Abafundi abathathu bacwangcisa intlanganiso enye yokufunda kule veki. Intlanganiso ithatha iiyure ezi-2.

민수: 이번 주에 스터디를 한 번 하면 어때요? 두 시간쯤 걸려요.
지연: 저는 월요일은 아르바이트가 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 4시부터 괜찮아요.
민수: 저는 수요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요.
수진: 저는 금요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 9시까지는 모임이 끝나야 해요.

(Onke amaxesha ngu-p.m. ngaphandle kokuba ixesha lithi ngenye indlela. '6시 이후' ibandakanya intsimbi yesi-6, kwaye '9시까지 끝나야 해요' ivumela intlanganiso iphele ngo-9 ncam.)
n-k-k7-02.thinking.2: Ukufumana isisombululo esingaphezulu kwesinye nokuqikelela utshintsho
n-k-k7-02.prereq.0: Uyazi amagama eentsuku zeveki namaxesha ewotshi
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.prompt: 민수 uthetha ntoni nge-'화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요'?
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.0: Fumana igama elahlula uLwesibini kwezinye iintsuku, ubuze ukuba lisusa ntoni kuLwesibini.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yitsho isivakalisi ngamagama akho kabini: kanye koLwesibini nekanye kwezinye iintsuku.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.a: Unokudibana ngoLwesibini kuphela, asoze adibane ngezinye iintsuku.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.a: '말고는' ibeka uLwesibini ecaleni kwezinye iintsuku; ayithi uLwesibini lusosuku olunye.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.b: Angadibana nganye imini emva kwe-6, kodwa ngoLwesibini hayi phambi kwe-6.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba uLwesibini lwalufana neminye imihla, ngekhe kubekho sizathu sokulukhankanya ngokwahlukileyo.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.c: NgoLwesibini akanalo umda onjalo; ngeminye imihla emva kwe-6 kuphela.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.d: Iiklasi zakhe ziphela nge-6 yonke imihla, kubandakanya uLwesibini.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.d: Ngoko '화요일 말고는' ngekhe ibe nengqiqo; uLwesibini sisaphulelo.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.explain: 'A 말고는 B' ithetha 'ngaphandle kwe-A, B'. Kuyo yonke imihla ngaphandle koLwesibini umda wemva kwe-6 uyabamba; uLwesibini sisaphulelo. (ULwesithathu lukhutshiwe sisivakalisi sakhe sangaphambili.)
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amaxesha ama-3 ahlukeneyo ahambelana nawo wonke umntu. d = inani losuku lweveki (1 = uMvulo ... 5 = uLwesihlanu), h = ixesha lokuqala kwiiyure ezipheleleyo kwiwotshi ye-24 (umzekelo 16 ithetha i-4 emva kwemini). Intlanganiso ithatha iiyure ezi-2.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.0: Susa imihla apho akukho namnye onokuza, uze ugqibe ixesha lokuqala lokuqala nelokugqibela kuyo yonke imihla eseleyo.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ixesha lokuphela lixesha lokuqala kunye neeyure ezi-2; lijonge ngokuchasene nomda ka-수진 ekugqibeleni.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c0: Inani losuku lweveki ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-5 kunye neyure epheleleyo.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Sebenzisa inani elipheleleyo losuku lweveki ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-5 kunye neyure epheleleyo yokuqala.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c2: 지연 ukhululekile ukusuka nge-4 emva kwemini.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c2: 지연 ukhululekile kuphela ukusuka nge-4 emva kwemini.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Ngaphandle koLwesibini, 민수 unokudibana kuphela emva kwe-6 emva kwemini.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Intlanganiso iphela iiyure ezi-2 kwaye kufuneka iphele ngo-9 ebusuku.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.explain: Emva kwemida emithathu yemihla, kuseleyo kuphela uLwesibini noLwesine. NgoLwesibini nasiphi na isiqalo ukusuka nge-4 ukuya nge-7 emva kwemini siyasebenza; ngoLwesine isiqalo kufuneka sibe yi-6 okanye i-7 emva kwemini (isiphelo kufuneka sibe ngo-9).
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha elinye lamaxesha akho uliphakamise kwincoko yeqela ngesiKorea (-요 enembeko): yitsho usuku lweveki nexesha lokuqala.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Thatha umqolo omnye ongasentla uze uthi usuku lwawo nexesha ngesiKorea.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Yongeza isiphelo sombuzo esinje nge--어때요? okanye isiphakamiso esilula nge--해요.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Usuku nexesha endilibhale lihambelana nelinye lamaxesha endawakhileyo?
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ndijonge ukuba akukho mda womntu ophukileyo?
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.2: Ikhankanya usuku olukhutshiweyo ukuze lususwe kuphela; oku kulungile.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku 수진 utshintsha ingqondo: '금요일도 괜찮아요. 대신 8시까지는 끝나야 해요.' Abanye ababini abatshintshi. Kwenzeka ntoni kumaxesha anokwenzeka?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda imiqathango ngomthetho omtsha: sisiphi isiqalo sokugqibela ngoku ukuba intlanganiso kufuneka iphele nge-8?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga uLwesihlanu kumntu ngamnye ngokulandelelana, emva koko uthelekise uluhlu lukaLwesibini noLwesine nolwakho lwangaphambili.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.a: ULwesihlanu nge-6 emva kwemini luyavuleka, kwaye iziqalo zangasemva ngoLwesibini noLwesine ziyancipha.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.b: Akukho nto intsha ivulekayo, kuba 민수 usengakwazi ukudibana ngoLwesihlanu.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.c: ULwesihlanu luyavuleka ukusuka nge-4 emva kwemini, njengoLwesibini.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.c: ULwesihlanu alunguLwesibini: 민수 unokudibana ngoLwesihlanu kuphela emva kwe-6 emva kwemini.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.d: ULwesihlanu luyavuleka, kwaye amaxesha oLwesine asala ngokuchanekileyo njengangaphambili.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.d: Ixesha lokuphela lamandulo lisika isiqalo sokugqibela yonke imihla, kubandakanya uLwesine.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.explain: Umthetho omtsha uthi: gqiba nge-8 ebusuku, ngoko isiqalo sifikelela kwi-6 emva kwemini. ULwesihlanu ngoku lufuna isiqalo esichanekileyo se-6 emva kwemini (민수 ufuna i-6 okanye emva kwayo, 수진 ngoku ufuna i-6 okanye ngaphambili). ULwesibini lulahlekelwa yi-7 emva kwemini kwaye uLwesine lugcina i-6 emva kwemini kuphela.

n-k-k7-01.title: Ukuthunyelwa simahla, kubani?
n-k-k7-01.goal: Vavanya amabango abathengi abaliqela ngokuchasene nesaziso sokuhambisa, ufumane ukuba ngawaphi amabango angaxhaswanga sisaziso, uze ulumkise umhlobo ngoko amele akuhlole.
n-k-k7-01.material:
Umhlobo uthenga kwi-intanethi kwaye ukubonisa isaziso sokuhambisa sevenkile. Abathengi abaliqela bathe bacinga ukuba sithetha ntoni.

[배송 안내]
1. 구매 금액이 30,000원 이상이면 배송비는 무료입니다. 단, 쿠폰으로 할인을 받으신 경우에는 할인된 금액을 기준으로 합니다.
2. 제주도와 섬 지역은 배송비 3,000원이 추가됩니다.
3. 오후 2시 이전에 결제하시면 당일에 출고됩니다.
n-k-k7-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ibango ngokuchasene namagama achanekileyo obungqina
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.prompt: Abathengi abane nganye uthenge into enye. Ngubani umthengi oya kungahlawuli nto kwaphela ngokuthunyelwa?
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ungathelekisi ixabiso lohlu nama-30,000 kwangoko. Dlula kwisivakalisi ngasinye esinamanani kwisaziso uphawule nantoni na etshintsha isixa esithelekiswayo okanye eyongeza iindleko.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumthengi ngamnye, fumana isixa esibalwayo, udwelise yonke into enye kwisaziso enokusebenza kuloo mthengi.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.a: 소라 (Seoul): ixabiso lohlu 33,000원, usebenzise ikhuphoni ye-5,000원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.a: Ikhuphoni ihlisa isixa esibalwayo. 33,000 - 5,000 = 28,000, nto leyo engaphantsi kwama-30,000.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.b: 준호 (Jeju Island): ixabiso lohlu 40,000원, akukho khuphoni
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.b: Isixa sakhe siphezulu ngokwaneleyo, kodwa isaziso songeza intlawulo eyahlukileyo yommandla wakhe, ngoko usahlawula into.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.c: 민지 (Seoul): ixabiso lohlu 36,000원, usebenzise ikhuphoni ye-5,000원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.d: 29,000 ingaphantsi kwama-30,000 kwaye akukho meko ayitshintshayo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.explain: 민지 uhlawula 36,000 - 5,000 = 31,000원, nto leyo engama-30,000 okanye ngaphezulu, kwaye iSeoul ayinayo intlawulo eyongezelelweyo. Isixa sika-소라 emva kwekhuphoni singama-28,000. 준호 ufumana ukuthunyelwa okusisiseko simahla kodwa isaziso songeza 3,000원 yeJeju. 태민 ungaphantsi komda.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.prompt: Abathengi bathetha ngoko bakuthengileyo. Khetha umgca omnye onebango LINGAXHASWANGA sisaziso (kusenokubakho nomgca ongaphezulu kwesinye; nawuphi na ubalwa).
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye, phinda ubale isixa esinokusetyenziswa yivenkile, uze uhlole ixesha okanye ummandla ukuba umgca uyawukhankanya.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga amagama amanani kwisaziso: ngawaphi abeka umda, kwaye ngowuphi uhlangothi lomda olavunyelwe?
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.explain: Imigca yesi-2 neyesi-4 ayixhaswanga. Umgca wesi-2: 32,000 - 4,000 = 28,000, ngaphantsi komda. Umgca wesi-4: ukuthunyelwa kwangaloo mini kudinga intlawulo phambi kwe-2 p.m. Umgca woku-1 ulungile (31,000, akukho khuphoni), umgca wesi-3 uhambelana nentlawulo yeJeju, kwaye umgca wesi-5 ungama-30,000 ncam, abalwa njengo-'이상'.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.prompt: Umhlobo e-제주도 ukubuza: '3만 원 넘게 사면 무료배송이지?' Phendula ngezivakalisi ezi-1-2 zesiKorean (i--요 enentlonipho iyavunyelwa; amagama ambalwa esiNgesi ayamkelekile) umxelele izinto ezimbini kwisaziso amele azihlole phambi kokuba alindele ukuthunyelwa simahla.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.0: Phinda ufunde isivakalisi ngasinye esinamanani kwisaziso ubuze ukuba sesiphi esinokutshintsha oko umhlobo wakho akuhlawulayo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala impendulo yombuzo wakhe kuqala, emva koko wongeze iimeko ezimbini nge-그런데 okanye 그리고.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndikhankanye zombini izinto: ummandla wakhe nesaphulelo?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba impendulo yam ilungisa inkolelo yakhe kunokuba iphinde umthetho nje?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Isimbo sentetho engekho semthethweni, nasona silungile kumhlobo osondeleyo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.model.2: Ekubeni uhlala e-제주도, kukho enye i-3,000원, kwaye ukuba usebenzisa 쿠폰 ixabiso elehliswe lelo libalwayo.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Impendulo exubileyo yesiNgesi isadlula ukuhlola kwangaphandle.

n-k-k7-03.title: Uphononongo luwela phi?
n-k-k7-03.goal: Hlaziya indlela oyifunda ngayo uphononongo lwekhefi njengoko inxalenye nganye ifika, qaphela esiphi isivakalisi sithwala ingongoma yombhali, uze ubhale icebiso eligcina omabini amacala.
n-k-k7-03.material: Umfundi wabhala uphononongo lwe-intanethi lwekhefi ekufutshane nenyuvesi. Umhlobo wakho ufuna ukufunda apho iiyure ezi-4 ngoMgqibelo. Uza kufunda uphononongo inxalenye ngenxalenye. (일부러 = ngabom, 콘센트 = indawo yombane, -(으)ㄹ 만하다 = kuyafaneleka ukwenza)
n-k-k7-03.thinking.1: Ukubona ukuba yeyiphi inxalenye yesivakalisi ethwala uluvo
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.prompt: Funda inxalenye nganye, ukhethe impendulo ebonakala inengqiqo kakhulu, uze uqhubeke.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.0: Latha ngokusebenzisa kuphela inxalenye oyifundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kwinxalenye nganye, jonga ukuba yeyiphi isivakalisi umbhali abonakala ekhathalele kakhulu.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Umbhali wayeya kuthi ntoni kumhlobo ofuna indawo yokufunda?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku kukho uncomo kuphela, ngoko ukuyincoma kuyindalo. Umfundi onenkathalo usenokulinda iinkcukacha ezongezelelekileyo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Umbhali uthi umculo 조용해서, oko kuthetha buthule.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Yiya apho kuphela ukuba uthanda izihlwele.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Mhlawumbi yiya, kodwa jonga iinkcukacha kuqala.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoku umbhali wayeya kuthi ntoni kumhlobo ofuna ukufunda apho wonke intwasahlobo?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Inxalenye yengxaki imalunga nokuhlala ixesha elide: iindawo ezimbalwa zombane, izitulo ezilukhuni. Uncomo lusenyani, kodwa icebiso lixhomekeke kwixesha olihlala ngalo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yiya apho; yeyona ndawo ilungileyo yokufunda ixesha elide.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Emva kwe-하지만 umbhali ubiza iingxaki ezibalulekileyo ekuhlaleni ixesha elide.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Umbhali usayincomile indawo; isikhalazo simalunga nokuhlala ixesha elide.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Fumana enye indawo yokufunda ixesha elide; le ilungele ukuhlala okufutshane.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Yiya apho ukuya kufunda ixesha elide, kodwa zisa itshaja yakho.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uphononongo lutsho ukuba ukuhlala ixesha elide kunzima; itshaja ayiyi kulungisa izitulo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sesiphi isivakalisi echaza uphononongo lonke ngokufanelekileyo?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Isiphelo siphinda uncomo kodwa sibophelele kumqathango: iyure enye okanye ezimbini. Isishwankathelo esifanelekileyo sigcina uncomo nomda.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ikhefi apho ingongoma ephambili yiingxaki zayo, uncomo lukhankanywe nje ngokungenelelayo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Isivakalisi sokugqibela sithi kuyafaneleka uhambo olukhethekileyo lokufunda okufutshane, ngoko uncomo alusiyongongoma esecaleni.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ikhefi entle, ethe cwaka efanele ukutyelelwa ukuhlala okufutshane kokufunda, hayi okude.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ikhefi epheleleyo kuzo zonke iintlobo zokufunda.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Inxalenye yesibini ibiza imida yokwenene kwiintlanganiso ezinde.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ikhefi elungele iseshoni yeeyure ezi-4 nangona kukho izitulo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Umbhali uthi ukuhlala kade kunzima, ngoko oku kuphikisana nophononongo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.reflect: Qaphela indlela icebiso lakho elitshintshe ngayo. Isivakalisi emva kwe-하지만 kunye ne-그래도 sihlala sibonisa oko umbhali afuna ukuba ukukhumbule, kwaye isishwankathelo esifanelekileyo kufuneka sigcine uncomo lokuqala nomda wamva kunye nomqathango (ixesha olihlala ngalo).
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.prompt: Umhlobo wakho ucebe iiyure ezi-4 zokufunda apho ngoMgqibelo. Mxelele ngesiKorea (nasiphi na isimbo esinembeko okanye esiqhelekileyo) into oyicebisayo, usebenzisa oko uphononongo lukuthethayo.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngenxalenye yophononongo ebaluleke kakhulu kwiiyure ezi-4.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.1: Yongeza isivakalisi esinye esifutshane ngoko indawo ilungele kona.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Icebiso lam lixhomekeke kwixesha aza kuhlala ngalo?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndigcine icala elihle loluphononongo kunye nengxaki?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.model.2: Kwiiyure ezi-4 ndiya kukhetha enye indawo: i-의자 zilukhuni kwaye ihamba ingenayo i-콘센트. Intle kwiyure yokufunda.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.modelNote.3: Inika isigqibo soluphononongo (ukuhlala okufutshane kuphela) endaweni yokubiza izitulo.

n-k-k7-04.title: Iduka kufuneka lazi ntoni?
n-k-k7-04.goal: Gqiba ukuba ngawaphi amaqhekeza olwazi umyalezo wokuqala wesikhalazo ewafunayo, ukhethe isicelo esingenakungaqondwa, uze ubhale umyalezo.
n-k-k7-04.material: Uyalele ijazi nge-intanethi. Uyalele ubungakanani be-L kodwa ijazi yobungakanani be-M ifike izolo, kwaye awukwazi ukuyinxiba. Uza kuthumela umyalezo wokuqala kwi-고객센터 yevenkile ubhalile. Ilungu lasebenzi alikwazi kwaye liphendula kuphela emva kokufunda umyalezo wakho.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.prompt: Ngawaphi amaqhekeza olwazi umyalezo wakho wokuqala kufuneka awuqulathe ukuze ivenkile isonjulule ingxaki ngaphandle kokubhala ukuba ikubuze? Khetha onke asebenzayo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ukuba ungumsebenzi: ziziphi iinyani obungaza kuzibuza phambi kokuba wenze nantoni na?
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.1: Susa oko ivenkile sele inako okanye oko kungatshintshi into eza kuyenza ngokulandelayo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba nembeko kulungile, kodwa uxolo alulolwazi iivenkile eziluqeqeshelwe ukwenza ngalo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.c: Ivenkile sele inayo idilesi kumyalelo, kwaye inombolo yomyalelo ibenza bayifumane.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.d: Yeyiphi into efikileyo nokuba yintoni engalunganga ngayo
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.f: Ukulibaziseka asiyiyo ingxaki apha; ubungakanani obungalunganga yiyo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.explain: Ivenkile kufuneka ikwazi ukufumana umyalelo (inombolo yomyalelo), iqonde ukuba kwahamba kwabi kakubi (into nobungakanani), kwaye iyazi ufuna ntoni ukuba yenziwe (utshintshiselwano okanye imbuyekezo). Uxolo, idilesi yakho nexesha lokuhanjiswa aziwanceda ukwenza.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.prompt: Sesiphi isivakalisi sesicelo esixelela ivenkile kanye into ekufuneka iyenze?
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kwisivakalisi ngasinye, buza ukuba umsebenzi usenokuzibuza ntoni emva kokusifunda.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.1: Isicelo esilungileyo siphendula 'yenza ntoni, ukuze ufumane ntoni?'
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.a: Oku kunokuthetha olunye ubungakanani, enye ibala okanye enye ijazi; ivenkile ayinakuxela.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.b: Sithi ngokukhawuleza kangakanani, hayi yintoni ekufuneka yenziwe.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.explain: 'L 사이즈로 교환해 주세요' ibiza isenzo (교환) nesiphumo (ubungakanani be-L). Ezinye izicelo zishiya ivenkile ikucinga ofuna ukukufumana.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umyalezo wakho kwi-고객센터 ngesiKorea (isimbo esinembeko okanye esisemthethweni, izivakalisi ezi-2-4). Yila inombolo yomyalelo.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngosuku olulungileyo nomhlathi omnye wokuba kutheni ubhala.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.1: Emva koko beka iinyani ezintathu ngokulandelelana: ngowuphi umyalelo, yintoni engalunganga, ufuna ntoni.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ilungu lasebenzi lingenza ngomyalezo wam ngaphandle kokubhala emva?
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ifutshane, -요 enembeko; isaqulathe iinyani ezintathu ezifunekayo.

n-k-k7-05.title: Wonke umntu? Hayi wonke umntu
n-k-k7-05.goal: Hlukanisa 'hayi wonke umntu' kwi-'akukho mntu', khetha ubungqina obophula ngenene ibango 'lwonke umntu', uze ubhale ibango lakho nomzekelo ophikisanayo onembeko.
n-k-k7-05.material: Kutshintshiselwano lweelwimi, undwendwe lutsho: "한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요." Wena nabafundi osebenza nabo nifuna ukuphendula ngembeko nangokuchanekileyo.
n-k-k7-05.prereq.0: Uyazi 모두, 다, 항상 kunye -지 않다
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.prompt: Kubahlobo abalishumi baseKorea obaziyo, abahlanu bathanda ukutya okubukhali kwaye abahlanu abathandi. Sesiphi isitetimenti esingeyonyani?
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bala ukuba zingaphi kwishumi isivakalisi ngasinye esimalunga nazo.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba isivakalisi sisabavumela na abahlanu abakuthandayo.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.a: Oko kuya kuthetha ukuba bonke abalishumi abakuthandi.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.d: Oko kuya kuthetha ukuba bonke abalishumi bayakuthanda.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.explain: '모두 ...는 것은 아니에요' ithi 'wonke umntu' akuyonyani, kodwa isavumela abanye abantu ukuba bakuthande. 'Akukho namnye' liyibango eliqinileyo kunezinto ezixhasa iinyani.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.prompt: Bungqina buphi obunye obonelayo ukubonisa ukuba '한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요' alulunganga?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isibhengezo simalunga nabo bonke abantu baseKorea nokuthanda. Buza ukuba ukhetho ngalunye lithini ngokuthanda, nangabani.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.1: Vavanya ukhetho ngalunye: ingaba lusayi kuba yinyani ukuba isibhengezo sasiyinyani?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.a: Lo ngumntu othanda ukutya okubukhali, kuhambelana nesibhengezo.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.b: Zikhona izitya ezininzi ezibukhali, kodwa oko akuthi nto ngomntu ngamnye ezithanda.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.c: Ukuthanda ukutya okubukhali kwaye kutyiwe kancinci akuliphuli isibhengezo, kuba isibhengezo simalunga nokuthanda.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.explain: Isibhengezo malunga nomntu wonke sinokuphulwa ngumntu omnye ongahambelaniyo. 민아 ngumKorea ongayithandiyo ukutya okubukhali. Akufuneki ubonise ukuba uninzi aluthandi.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.prompt: Yenza isibini sakho semigca ngesiKorea (esinembeko). A uthi into enamandla kakhulu ngeqela, esebenzisa igama elifana ne-모두, 다 okanye 항상 (umzekelo ngabafundi, isixeko okanye ukutya). B uphendula ngenkathalo ngomzekelo othile ochasayo kwaye uthi asiyonyani kumntu wonke.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha iqela olaziyo kakuhle, uze ubhale isivakalisi sika-A esinegama elinye le-'bonke / ngalo lonke ixesha'.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kuka-B, cinga ngomntu omnye wokwenene okanye imeko engahambelaniyo, uze uthi 'hayi wonke umntu' kunokuthi 'akukho namnye'.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba isibhengezo sika-A simalunga nawo wonke umntu ngokwenene, ukuze umzekelo omnye usiphule?
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba impendulo ka-B inamandla kanye njengomzekelo, hayi amandla ngakumbi?
